import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t**2)
    amp = p[3] + p[4]*t
    n = p[5]
    K = np.abs(p[6])*np.exp(p[7]*t)
    An = np.abs(A)**n
    S = An/(K + An)
    return base + amp*S
